name: decomposition-microfrontends
description: Angular micro-frontends target state — shell + remote apps using Webpack Module Federation

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:shell" "npm run dev:identity" "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:product"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:identity && npm run build:customer && npm run build:order && npm run build:product && npm run build:shell
scripts.test:all: concurrently "cd apps/shell && npx vitest run" "cd apps/identity-mfe && npx vitest run" "cd apps/customer-mfe && npx vitest run" "cd apps/order-mfe && npx vitest run" "cd apps/product-mfe && npx vitest run"
